name: ぱらぱら草
notes: New 2026-09-11 model for the user's 'a blade or two here and there' request; used for 25 of every 60 kept ground-cover spots in the grassland.
Dense 278,972 -> 12,550 triangles (p95 0.1 mm). Height 0.45 m, ground-centred pivot. Drawn within 1.1 m, impostor beyond 1.1 m to 24 m.

2026-09-11 root recolour requested by the user ("no brown at the grass root"): scripts/recolor-grass-root.mjs re-hues the dull olive texels the lowest 18% of the vertices reference (mean RGB 73,94,44) to the leaf-green chromaticity at each texel's own luminance (now 22,102,11); geometry, UVs and normals are byte-identical.

2026-09-12 root cap removed (user: green base under grass): TRELLIS had sealed the bottom of the clump with a nearly flat root disc (250 flat triangles within +-0.04 m) that the root recolour turned into a green mound. scripts/cut-grass-root.mjs drops every triangle whose highest vertex is below 0.03 m (12,550 -> 11,765 triangles, 785 removed); vertices, normals, UVs, material and texture are byte-identical and the height is unchanged. The placement sink (world-scenery.ts / regional-scenery.ts) was raised so the cut edge sits below the ground.
